findings.issue: Receipt cites base_commit 9367596c9ff7b625e2fc13eed3581f11815b2c83, not claimed BASE 9c3cc78a nor CANDIDATE ea736919. The 212-test and Pyright PASS receipts are not SHA-bound to the reviewed candidate tree; CODE_DIFF_SHA256 also unverified.
findings.minimal_fix: Re-run focused tests and full-tree Pyright on ea736919 and issue a receipt citing that exact candidate head plus per-file SHA256 matching the candidate blobs.

findings.issue: Design §10 (L0425-0428) permits mechanical context_capacity_unavailable HOLD only when raw group absent AND validated exact-ref cannot legally project. Code never attempts or checks exact-ref recovery; docstring defers it, so runs with legally projectable exact-refs are hard-held, diverging from the sole permitted HOLD criterion.
findings.minimal_fix: Either implement bounded owner-scoped exact-ref projection check before HOLD, or gate deployment in config and document the HOLD as an explicitly temporary conservative batch with the divergence recorded in design.

findings.issue: Invalid (incomplete/multi-call partial) latest group always returns not-visible and the rebuild path only runs for valid groups, so a repairable pairing anomaly becomes a hard observation_guard_fault/context_capacity_unavailable HOLD without trying _repair_tool_call_pairing.
findings.minimal_fix: On invalid group, attempt existing pairing repair or emit distinct reason (e.g. protocol_pairing_fault) so diagnostics distinguish capacity vs pairing anomalies.

findings.issue: provider_sent=false is only asserted inside human-readable final_answer text plus an event payload action string; no structured boolean field on the run result is shown in the diff.
findings.minimal_fix: Add structured provider_sent=false and run_incomplete fields to the result object and assert them in tests, not just substring checks.

findings.issue: When raw_fits succeeds, the helper silently swaps the engine's projected messages for rebuilt.messages; cache-prefix/prompt-budget effects of the swap are only asserted via request_preflight hard_overflow, not cache-epoch stability.
findings.minimal_fix: Emit cache/epoch metadata in the request.observation_visibility event and add a regression that the rebuild preserves cache prefix boundaries.
